title: P1.02-M shabu seized, 2 arrested in Camarines Sur

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — Police arrested two suspected drug personalities and seized 150 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) worth P1.02 million during an anti-drug operation in Tinambac town in Camarines Sur on Sunday, Nov. 22. The operation was conducted around 3:30 p.m. in Zone 5, Barangay Binalay, by the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit 5, in coordination with the Tinambac Municipal Police Station, Camarines Sur Provincial Intelligence Unit, Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit, and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Region 5. Police Lt. Col. Maria Luisa Calubaquib, Bicol police information officer, identified the arrested suspects only by their aliases, “Reni” […]...
